description: This file defines interfaces for system control, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata within the Thunder framework, including classes like ISystem, IDiscovery, IConfiguration, ILifeTime, IMetadata, and related nested structures.

classes.name: ISystem
classes.description: Interface for system operations such as reboot, delete, clone, destroy, and environment variable retrieval.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting SSDP discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration persistence and retrieval.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifetime, including activation, deactivation, suspension, hibernation, and notifications.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing detailed metadata about the framework, plugins, connections, and system build info.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: StartDiscovery
methods.description: Starts SSDP network discovery with optional TTL.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores all configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Hibernates a plugin with a timeout.

methods.name: ForwardMessage
methods.description: Notifies all events forwarded by the framework.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Retrieves call stack information for a thread.

methods.name: BuildInfo
methods.description: Retrieves build information about the system.
